    • getName

      String getName()
      Returns the name of this player 返回此玩家的名称

      Names are no longer unique past a single game session. For persistent storage it is recommended that you use getUniqueId() instead. 名称在单个游戏会话之外不再唯一。对于持久化存储，建议改用 getUniqueId()。

      指定者:
      getName 在接口中 AnimalTamer
      返回:
      Player name or null if we have not seen a name for this player yet 玩家名称，若尚未见过此玩家的名称则为 null

    • getPlayer

      Player getPlayer()
      Gets a Player object that this represents, if there is one 获取此对象所代表的 Player（如果存在）

      If the player is online, this will return that player. Otherwise, it will return null. 如果该玩家在线，则返回该玩家；否则返回 null。

      返回:
      Online player 在线玩家

    • getFirstPlayed

      long getFirstPlayed()
      Gets the first date and time that this player was witnessed on this server. 获取此玩家第一次被记录到本服务器的时间。

      If the player has never played before, this will return 0. Otherwise, it will be the amount of milliseconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC. 如果该玩家从未游玩过，则返回 0；否则返回自 1970 年 1 月 1 日 UTC 午夜起经过的毫秒数。

      返回:
      Date of first log-in for this player, or 0 该玩家首次登录的日期，或 0

    • getLastPlayed

      long getLastPlayed()
      Gets the last date and time that this player was witnessed on this server. 获取此玩家最后一次被记录到本服务器的时间。

      If the player has never played before, this will return 0. Otherwise, it will be the amount of milliseconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 如果该玩家从未游玩过，则返回 0；否则返回自 1970 年 1 月 1 日 UTC 午夜起经过的毫秒数。 UTC.

      返回:
      Date of last log-in for this player, or 0 该玩家最后登录的日期，或 0

    • getBedSpawnLocation

      Location getBedSpawnLocation()
      Gets the Location where the player will spawn at their bed, null if they have not slept in one or their current bed spawn is invalid. 获取玩家在其床边重生的位置；如果玩家从未在床上睡过或当前床的重生点已失效，则为 null。
      返回:
      Bed Spawn Location if bed exists, otherwise null. 床的重生位置（如果床存在），否则为 null。
